summary: In the Haa district, forests dominate the landscape, covering 1,238.28 km² (65.0 %). Meadows and alpine scrubs are the next most extensive land‑uses, with 215.08 km² (11.3 %) and 205.65 km² (10.8 %) respectively. Remaining land is mainly shrubland (87.11 km², 4.6 %) and rocky outcrops (59.20 km², 3.1 %), with minor allocations for snow and glacier, agriculture, and various small features.
